title: Rivulet LocalOps
description: Turns a written service policy into decisions that can be executed, checked and traced to a named owner. The reference scenario is a council handling waste and litter requests.
bullets: AI-assisted and policy-gated: a model reads the request and suggests type and urgency, but the written policy decides what may happen — it may raise urgency and never lower it — and a named person makes the final call.
Every request is diagnosed, tested against the approved policy, recorded in a tamper-evident ledger and reviewed by a second person.
An independent prototype, not an official council service: no real resident requests, and no writes to any real council system.

title: LifeOps Atlas
description: A single-user operations system that brings tasks, relationships, event research and career preparation into one evidence-backed workspace.
bullets: Durable records live in PostgreSQL with append-only corrections and source evidence; the AI works only from bounded, traceable input.
Node.js 24, TypeScript, Fastify 5, Zod, PostgreSQL 17 and Docker Compose. The public edition is a sanitised walkthrough built from synthetic records.

title: AgriSentry
description: A configurable farm-monitoring system on the Microsoft Power Platform: simulated weather and sensor data become per-crop risk alerts.
bullets: A person approves every alert before anything happens, with an immutable audit trail behind it and a Power BI dashboard over it.
Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate and Power BI with an Azure Functions rule engine. Synthetic data; the application source stays private.

title: Evan.H Portfolio
description: This site. A portfolio has two readers — someone skimming for facts, and someone who wants to look around — so it is built twice over one set of content.
bullets: Every word lives in content/*.json behind a typed loader that fails the build on a broken link, an invented status or a second language, with 104 tests behind it.
The same content renders as this page and as an explorable canvas deck with a voice guide that can only say what the slides say.

title: Tasmania Student Notes
description: An independent, student-led publication for Tasmania in six languages, with a newsroom of four AI roles where a human editor approves every final result.
bullets: A six-language preview site on Ghost's Headline theme, with a pixel office that replays recorded pilot runs.

The newsroom — Coordinator, Researcher, Writer and Checker — runs privately in Docker on the editor's own computer; the Coordinator handles routine hand-offs and the editor approves every published result.
A prototype with no published stories yet: the pilot runs used fictional material.

title: AI-Native Payment & Agent Engineering Lab
description: A payment-processing prototype and a read-only operations copilot, built to find where agent workflows break rather than to demo where they work.
bullets: Designed a FastAPI/SQLite payment-processing prototype normalising synchronous, webhook and polling results from three simulated channels through adapters, event de-duplication, audit logging and a deterministic state machine.

Verified a read-only RAG operations copilot with three tools and a Planner–Developer–Tester–Reviewer process, using 77 automated tests, 11 documented failure cases, human approval and code-level safety gates.

title: Cyber Finance City
description: Modular UE5 financial-education system with AI-driven NPCs and a FastAPI + RAG backend.
bullets: Created a modular UE5 interactive experience with AI-driven NPCs, configurable questions, scoring workflows, PBR environments, and VR-ready interactions.
Connected the UE5 client to FastAPI, structured question data, RAG retrieval, and LLM services, then validated API, integration, and end-to-end interaction workflows.

title: Little Red: Sequel
description: Independently developed story-driven 3D pixel-style Unreal Engine indie game demo.
bullets: Developed a story-driven 3D pixel-style Unreal Engine game demo featuring dark-fantasy worldbuilding, hub-based exploration, nonlinear quests, interactive dialogue, and multiple endings.
Modified and combined Marketplace quest, dialogue and menu systems with custom Blueprints, and built the AIGC-assisted asset production that put 2D pixel art onto 3D environments.
